instruction:
The file `/home/user/Desktop/legacy.sch` is the schematic to update. On Linux, launch CadSoft EAGLE with `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` (adjust to your install).

It contains a single TO-220 LM7805 linear regulator (U1) wired between VIN and VOUT nets with two decoupling caps (C1=100n on VIN, C2=10u on VOUT) and GND return. Replace U1 with a pin-compatible AMS1117-5.0 in SOT-223. Save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/replaced.sch`. Requirements: 1. File parses as EAGLE XML. 2. NO <part> references LM7805 / 7805 anywhere in its deviceset / device / value attributes (the old regulator is fully gone). 3. At least one <part> references AMS1117 (e.g. Deviceset "AMS1117-5.0"). 4. The AMS1117 deviceset's <connects> map the regulator's input pin to pad 3, output pin to pad 2, and GND pin to pad 1 (pad "1 4" including the SOT-223 tab is also accepted). 5. C1 and C2 (the two decoupling caps) are still present. 6. Nets VIN, GND, VOUT are still present.
